units.source_text: 嗯，最近我可以凭自己的感觉，知道哪一种类型的女人喜欢生就一双X型腿的男子汉。

en.t: Well, lately I can tell by my own instinct what type of woman likes a man who was born with a pair of X-shaped legs.

units.source_text: 女人当中是有这种类型的人的。

en.t: There really are women of that type.

units.source_text: 所谓喜欢生就一双X型腿的男子汉，说不定这是她一生的隐私，

en.t: This liking for men born with X-shaped legs may well be the private secret of her whole life,

units.source_text: 她会把它一起带到坟墓去呢。

en.t: and she may carry it with her all the way to the grave.

units.source_text: 尽管那是这种类型的女人惟一的怪癖，惟一的梦。

en.t: Even though it is the only oddity and the only dream of women of that type.
